sentences.text: All this structure can be written as a signature.
The homogeneous categorial extension of Sigma adds, for every sort and every dimension K below N, a K source, a K target and a K composition.
Each composition comes with a domain condition, an existence equation:
the composite of two cells is defined exactly when the K source of the first equals the K target of the second.
These conditions only use sources and targets, which have none, so they form a well-founded hierarchy.
This makes it a hierarchical equationally partial signature, or H E P signature.
Over such a signature, an E P algebra is a partial algebra in which every operation is defined exactly where its domain conditions hold:
composition, exactly at the composable pairs.
And the N categorial algebras are exactly the E P algebras over this signature that satisfy a set of Q E equations.
